# PayCensus Agent Network

> Verified machine-payment census, behaviour taxonomy and trust ranking for
> the x402 / agentic economy. Every endpoint below is free JSON, no key,
> CORS open. Scores derive from on-chain settlement behaviour only.

## Data
- [Agent Trust Rank](/data/rank.json): ranked machine-payable endpoints —
  score = 40% volume + 25% buyer diversity + 15% ticket sanity + 20% identity.
  Noise classes (dust, self-probes, faucets) excluded by construction.
- [Behaviour taxonomy](/data/agent_map.json): five-class classification of
  23k+ selling addresses (real_commerce / agent_chain / self_probe /
  dust_noise / aggregator / low_signal).
- [Bazaar coverage](/data/bazaar_stats.json): x402 Bazaar indexing coverage
  with 30-day demand signals (unique payers, calls per endpoint).

## Trust
- [Verify a seller](https://trust.paycensus.com/verify.html): on-chain +
  domain-control verification, free tier forever. Optional address-ownership
  proof: sign paycensus-addr-proof=<nonce> with the payment key during
  verification — verified records then carry addr_proven=1.

## MCP
- MCP endpoint: POST https://agent.paycensus.com/mcp (streamable HTTP JSON-RPC;
  no key). Tools: agent_rank (min_score / cls / verified / limit), agent_map,
  bazaar_stats. Point any MCP client at this URL to query the census.

## Dogfood
- https://agent.paycensus.com/dogfood.html: our own agent buys weekly
  from top-ranked merchants with real USDC via x402; every outcome
  (success and failure) is published in /data/dogfood_log.json.

## Paid data (x402)
- Machine-payable: GET https://agent.paycensus.com/api/x402/rank - the full
  Agent Trust Rank snapshot for 0.001 USDC per call (x402 v2, Base, no key
  needed, EIP-3009 settlement). Recommended agent budget: $5/month covers
  5,000 calls. Free alternatives: /data/*.json snapshots and /mcp tools.
